title: Build completion-contract event (one record per event, JSON object per line in the build journal)
description: T005a (owner decision C1, plan KC-P2). Producer: the remote emitter scripts/build/remote/emit.sh on the build host. Consumers: the event hub scripts/build/event_hub.sh and the consume core scripts/build/event_core.sh. seq is per build, from 1, strictly increasing. hmac is HMAC-SHA256 (lowercase hex) over the canonical bytes of the event without the hmac field (the CANONICAL FORM: Python json.dumps(event minus hmac, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8, i.e. compact, keys sorted by code point, non-ASCII characters emitted raw, only the mandatory JSON string escapes, integers in plain decimal, no floats; jq -cS reproduces the same bytes ONLY on the fixtures of test_dispatch_events.sh and not in general: for the character U+007F (DEL) jq -cS emits the escape \u007f while Python emits the raw character, so an emitter MUST NOT rely on jq -cS for arbitrary text; an emitter MUST reproduce the Python form exactly and a cross-implementation fixture for the emitter is OWED to T005b; scripts/build/lib/bev_crypto.py) under the per-build key HKDF-SHA256(driver secret, salt empty, info = len4be(build_id) || build_id || len4be(run_id) || run_id). Integers are bounded to 2^53-1 and the core refuses floats, booleans and duplicate keys; host, sent_at and image_digest are at most 1024 characters (the core caps them identically); the raw event is at most 65536 bytes (the core refuses a larger one before parsing it: a byte cap on the transport that JSON Schema cannot express); the core additionally binds an event to the build's submit record (run_id and variant must equal the recorded ones) and requires the first event of a build to be accepted with seq 1; build_id matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$ (no dot). Initial draft written by the T005a slice 2026-10-05; UNCONFIRMED against the full T005a text beyond the fields it lists (elapsed_monotonic_ms and stage typing are this draft's choice).
